about_the_game: Kiwi's Adventure is a fangame made for the Avalon Vtuber group. Play as Kiwi, Narin's adorable mascot, and go on a quest to find her after she has gone missing! Travel through the realm of each Avalon member, gaining gifts of power from each of them to help you reach Narin! Flap your way through 7 unique zones of varying difficulty, dodging pillars and meeting gods, and use powerful abilities gifted to you by the members of Avalon. Fill your compendium with each god and learn about their divine upbringings as you journey through their realms. Keep taking to the sky as many times as it takes to reach the Goddess of the Tempest, Narinji. This Game features a simple an engaging gameloop, striking visuals, and an automatic save system, making for an enjoyable experience even for non-fans of Avalon.
